question_text: What is the primary purpose of video editing?
options: Arrange and refine video and audio into a coherent sequence
correct_answer: Arrange and refine video and audio into a coherent sequence

question_text: What does a video editing timeline primarily represent?
options: The arrangement of media over time
correct_answer: The arrangement of media over time

question_text: What is a video clip?
options: A segment of recorded or imported video
correct_answer: A segment of recorded or imported video

question_text: What does trimming a clip generally mean?
options: Removing unwanted portions from its beginning or end
correct_answer: Removing unwanted portions from its beginning or end

question_text: What does video resolution describe?
options: The number of pixels forming each video frame
correct_answer: The number of pixels forming each video frame

question_text: What does aspect ratio describe?
options: The proportional relationship between frame width and height
correct_answer: The proportional relationship between frame width and height

question_text: What does frame rate measure?
options: The number of video frames displayed per second
The duration of an audio sample
correct_answer: The number of video frames displayed per second

question_text: What is a video codec primarily responsible for?
correct_answer: Encoding and decoding video data

question_text: Which of the following is a common video container format?
correct_answer: MP4

question_text: What does an audio waveform visually represent?
options: Changes in audio amplitude over time
correct_answer: Changes in audio amplitude over time

question_text: What is a video transition used for?
options: Changing from one shot or clip to another
correct_answer: Changing from one shot or clip to another

question_text: What are titles commonly used for in video editing?
options: Displaying text such as names, headings, or credits
correct_answer: Displaying text such as names, headings, or credits

question_text: What does exporting a video mean?
options: Rendering the edited project into a playable media file
correct_answer: Rendering the edited project into a playable media file

question_text: What is non-linear video editing?
options: Editing media in any order without physically altering the original recording
Editing only from beginning to end
correct_answer: Editing media in any order without physically altering the original recording

question_text: What is B-roll?
options: Supplementary footage used to support the main footage
correct_answer: Supplementary footage used to support the main footage

question_text: In an L-cut, what typically continues into the next shot?
correct_answer: Audio from the previous shot

question_text: In a J-cut, what typically begins before the corresponding video appears?
correct_answer: Audio from the upcoming shot

question_text: What are keyframes used for in video editing?
options: Defining values at specific points so properties can change over time
correct_answer: Defining values at specific points so properties can change over time

question_text: What is the primary goal of color correction?
options: Make footage technically balanced and consistent
correct_answer: Make footage technically balanced and consistent

question_text: What is color grading primarily used for?
options: Creating a desired visual style or mood
correct_answer: Creating a desired visual style or mood

question_text: What does white balance correction help achieve?
options: Accurate or intentionally controlled color appearance under different lighting
correct_answer: Accurate or intentionally controlled color appearance under different lighting

question_text: What is audio mixing?
options: Balancing and processing multiple audio tracks
correct_answer: Balancing and processing multiple audio tracks

question_text: What is audio ducking commonly used for?
options: Automatically lowering background audio when dialogue is present
correct_answer: Automatically lowering background audio when dialogue is present

question_text: What does video stabilization attempt to reduce?
correct_answer: Unwanted camera movement or shake

question_text: What is chroma keying commonly used for?
options: Removing a selected color background and replacing it with another visual
correct_answer: Removing a selected color background and replacing it with another visual

question_text: What is masking used for in video editing?
options: Restricting an effect or adjustment to a selected region
correct_answer: Restricting an effect or adjustment to a selected region

question_text: Why are proxy files used during video editing?
options: To edit using lower-resolution copies for smoother performance
To permanently reduce original footage quality
correct_answer: To edit using lower-resolution copies for smoother performance

question_text: What does video bitrate represent?
options: The amount of data used to represent video per unit of time
The number of frames in the timeline
correct_answer: The amount of data used to represent video per unit of time

question_text: What is the main purpose of video compression?
options: Reduce the amount of data needed to store or transmit video
Increase the physical size of pixels
correct_answer: Reduce the amount of data needed to store or transmit video

question_text: What is a key characteristic of lossy video compression?
options: It discards some information to achieve greater compression
It always preserves every original bit
correct_answer: It discards some information to achieve greater compression

question_text: What is an I-frame in many video compression schemes?
options: A frame encoded independently of other frames
A frame that must always be transparent
A frame used only for subtitles
correct_answer: A frame encoded independently of other frames

question_text: Why is YCbCr commonly used for digital video?
options: It separates luminance from chrominance and supports efficient compression
It eliminates the need for codecs
It represents video only as grayscale
correct_answer: It separates luminance from chrominance and supports efficient compression

question_text: What does chroma subsampling reduce in video compression?
options: The spatial resolution of color information
correct_answer: The spatial resolution of color information

question_text: What does dynamic range in video primarily describe?
options: The range between the darkest and brightest levels that can be represented
correct_answer: The range between the darkest and brightest levels that can be represented

question_text: What is a major characteristic of HDR video?
options: It can represent a wider range of brightness and color than standard dynamic-range video
correct_answer: It can represent a wider range of brightness and color than standard dynamic-range video

question_text: What does audio sample rate determine?
options: How many audio samples are captured per second
The number of video frames per second
correct_answer: How many audio samples are captured per second

question_text: What does audio bit depth primarily affect?
options: The precision used to represent each audio sample and the available dynamic range
correct_answer: The precision used to represent each audio sample and the available dynamic range
